data.title: Israel reports troop deaths as Lebanon talks continue
data.description: JERUSALEM - Israel on Thursday reported its first military fatalities in southern Lebanon in more than a month, after carrying out fresh strikes despite ongoing US-backed talks in Rome aimed at ending hostilities.

data.title: Iran and Oman close to agreement on Hormuz
data.description: TEHRAN - Iran and Oman have agreed a route for ships transiting the Strait of Hormuz and were finalising arrangements for jointly managing the strategic waterway, Tehran said on Wednesday, even as fresh security incidents highlighted continued risks for regional shipping.

data.title: New Zealand PM open to referendum on electoral system
data.description: WELLINGTON - New Zealand Prime Minister Christopher Luxon said on Thursday he was open to a referendum on whether to change the country’s electoral system, opening another split in his centre-right coalition months ahead of a general election.

data.title: Body of popular Thai YouTuber Hlun Solo returns home
data.description: The body of the popular Thai travel YouTuber Hlun Solo was returned to Thailand early Thursday morning, as his family prepared to seek an autopsy to find the cause of his death in Georgia last month.

data.title: Indian youth protests highlight mistrust in ‘lapdog’ media
data.description: NEW DELHI - Journalists covering last month’s youth-led protests in India became targets of public anger and attacks over their perceived support for the government, exposing a deepening crisis of trust in traditional broadcasters.

data.title: Police raid South Korean FA as World Cup fallout continues
data.description: SEOUL - Police raided South Korea’s football association on Thursday as part of an investigation into the appointment of the coach in charge during their dismal World Cup campaign.

data.title: ‘Unsustainable’ number of child migrants in Ceuta
data.description: CEUTA, Spain - The leader of Spain’s north African territory of Ceuta on Wednesday said the number of children left there after last week’s rush of migrants was “unsustainable”, pleading for government aid.

data.title: Istanbul cymbals: From Ottoman war tool to pulse of global music
data.description: ISTANBUL - The rhythmic clanging of hammers on bronze echoes through the Istanbul workshop where three craftsmen are landing blows with astonishing precision to transform featureless metal discs into highly prized handcrafted cymbals.

data.title: ONE Championship: Phetjeeja to defend kickboxing title against newcomer Antonia Prifti, source says
data.description: ONE Championship women's atomweight kickboxing champion Phetjeeja Lukjaoporongtom will defend her belt against newly signed Greek star Antonia Prifti at The Inner Circle 28, the Bangkok Post understands.

data.title: Dinosaur fossils unearthed in Chaiyaphum
data.description: More than 100 dinosaur fossil fragments estimated to be over 130 million years old have been found in Chaiyaphum, raising hopes of identifying one of Thailand's oldest known carnivorous dinosaurs.

data.title: Back to the future as champion Springboks host All Blacks
data.description: JOHANNESBURG - Hosts South Africa and visitors New Zealand are going back to the future with a rugby tour that begins in Cape Town on Friday and ends 12,700 kilometres away in the United States.

data.title: Chinese tax fugitive caught
data.description: PATHUM THANI: A Chinese woman wanted for an alleged 172 million baht tax fraud in China was arrested near Talaad Thai Market after months of evading immigration investigators.

data.title: LG marks 38 years in Thailand, launches 'Make It Yours. Make It Easy.' campaign
data.description: LG Electronics (Thailand) Co Ltd, the global innovation leader in home appliances from South Korea, has reaffirmed its long-standing commitment to business excellence and community engagement in Thailand with the official launch of its 38th anniversary campaign under the concept "LG Make It Yours. Make It Easy."

data.title: Coalition shows unity amid rumours
data.description: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul and Pheu Thai leader Julapun Amornvivat put on a public display of unity on Tuesday, dismissing speculation the ruling coalition could fracture ahead of an expected no-confidence debate later this year.

data.description: DUBAI - Oman is facing an impending environmental catastrophe as an alleged Russian shadow fleet tanker leaks oil across hundreds of square kilometres near a nature reserve, NGOs warn.

data.description: Chok Maa, a new artist residency and exhibition space in Bangkok, presents "Difference And Repetition: Contemporary Thai Printmaking", an exhibition celebrating the breadth, craftsmanship and innovation of contemporary printmaking in Thailand, from Saturday to Sept 26.

data.description: Aston Villa continued their Asian pre‑season tour with a composed 3‑1 victory over BG Pathum United in Bangkok, the Europa League holders showing their quality despite a rain‑soaked delay that pushed kick‑off back by 45 minutes.

data.title: Navy rejects claims over bunker safety
data.description: The Royal Thai Navy (RTN) has rejected claims that border bunkers in Chanthaburi and Trat are unsafe or poorly built, saying photographs circulated online showed unfinished construction and did not reflect the overall condition of the facilities.

data.title: 60bn gold card budget reviewed
data.description: A review of 60 billion baht from the 2025 universal healthcare budget is under way, says Public Health Minister Pattana Promphat, after he questioned whether the money had been properly allocated.
